# 247CTF

> > 247CTF is a continuous Capture The Flag (CTF) platform offering 24/7 cybersecurity training through hands-on hacking challenges across multiple difficulty levels.

247CTF provides an always-on environment for security enthusiasts to practice exploitation techniques, solve challenges, and compete on monthly leaderboards. The platform features beginner-friendly progression paths and an active community on Discord, Twitter, and YouTube.

## Key Topics

- Capture The Flag (CTF)
- Cybersecurity Training
- Hacking Challenges
- Security Competitions
- Continuous Learning
- Progress Tracking
- Monthly Leaderboards
- Beginner-Friendly Challenges
- Security Practice
- Online CTF Platform
- Challenge Categories
- Community Rankings
- Discord Community

## Getting Started

- [247CTF - The game never stops](https://247ctf.com/): Main homepage for the continuous CTF platform offering 24/7 cybersecurity training and hacking challenges
- [About 247CTF](https://247ctf.com/about): Platform overview including rules, features, community links, and information about the 247CTF project
- [Begin Your Journey](https://247ctf.com/progress/begin): Starting point for new users to begin tracking their CTF challenge progress and learning path
- [Beginner Progress](https://247ctf.com/progress/beginner): Beginner-level challenge tracker showing category-specific progress statistics and achievements

## User Dashboard & Tracking

- [Dashboard](https://www.247ctf.com/dashboard): Personal dashboard for monitoring your CTF challenge progress, statistics, and achievements
- [Activity Feed](https://247ctf.com/activity): Real-time activity feed displaying recent user challenge completions and platform events

## Competition & Rankings

- [Monthly Scoreboard](https://247ctf.com/scoreboard/monthly): Monthly CTF competition leaderboard showing top performers and current rankings

## Optional

- [247CTF Instance](https://48c7a2115b3dc30e.247ctf.com/): Alternate instance URL for accessing 247CTF challenges and platform features
